evidence.detail: suite-reuse/closure and its sub-rows: a cold run is all fresh, an untouched qualified suite hits, and each changed input misses exactly the suites it reaches (own input content, added, deleted and mode-changed files, a prerequisite input, the manifest entry, the dispatcher, a tool tree, the authority, base and declared environment values, a qualification, another root). Unknown closures get no key: edited suite, prerequisite or shared code, an unqualified prerequisite, a missing closure, a suite of the unconfined leg, an unreviewed state or side effect, an unreadable registry, a prerequisite of a shared-namespace suite, unknown prerequisites of a shared-namespace suite. The qualifications are the authority's: a candidate that qualifies itself or declares fewer inputs changes nothing.

The real dispatcher over the fixture: every qualified suite runs in a process of its own with its prerequisite closure; state an earlier suite leaves cannot hide a failure (the review's counterexample: red in the first run, after the earlier suite changes, and under force fresh, nothing stored); a changed prerequisite input runs the dependent fresh; a fresh dependent executes its prerequisite in its own process; new inputs hit once observed.

Declared: suite206-key-drops-prerequisite-state turns suite-reuse/closure false. Also key-omits-input-content, stale-qualification-accepted, environment-not-in-key, root-not-in-key, unconfined-suite-reusable, dispatcher-skips-prerequisite, qualified-suite-runs-in-shared-namespace, prerequisite-of-shared-suite-isolated, candidate-qualifies-itself.

suite-reuse/pass-only and its sub-rows, each through the VELDO-0205 store and the real dispatcher: a passing isolated run is stored and reused; a failed run, a run ended early (stopped when the suite said through a FIFO that it got there, no sleep), a selector run and a run whose account says partial store nothing; a selector run over a warm store still executes, exits 2 and prints no aggregate line; edited, truncated, emptied, re-checksummed and other-suite records, and eleven signed records of anything but a complete passing isolated run (a shared-namespace observation and an earlier schema among them), run fresh; an unusable store runs fresh.

A plan is honored only by the unit stage's own dispatcher: a reordered run (then red at settlement), another root, the unconfined leg, a suite the list names, a malformed plan and a process whose output is not the unit stage's file isolate and leave out nothing.

Declared: suite206-partial-run-published turns suite-reuse/pass-only false. Also partial-record-accepted, unfinished-run-published, failed-run-published, selector-run-reused, other-root-plan-honored, shared-observation-not-flagged, plan-honored-on-any-output.

suite-reuse/receipts and its sub-rows: exact cold, warm and mixed counts with every manifest suite and its key; force fresh reads and writes no record and names the same keys; the stamp fields carry the reused count, the counts and each qualified suite's key beside its source, and the landing verifier refuses a reused count; kept, renamed and re-signed stale records are never a hit; a fresh failure is red beside hits; a forged, missing, doubled, foreign or unfinished account, an isolated run without its prerequisite closure, a shared suite beside a left-out prerequisite and inputs changed during the stage make the settlement red; both legs are covered.

The production verify.sh over the fixture, serial path: cold green with unit 0, warm green with reused.unit 5, the suites field with counts and exact keys in stamp and event, force fresh runs every suite, a fresh failure beside five hits is GATE RED, a passing stage that leaves a suite unaccounted is GATE RED, no plan is GATE RED, and the stages before and after the unit stage never find the plan. Scheduler-shaped node output, written to the files the plan step made, is settled by the gate's own command.

Declared: suite206-fresh-failure-ignored-after-hit turns suite-reuse/receipts false.
